info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Brokered Product Update API
info.description: The Brokered Product Update API facilitates the modification of existing brokered product details within the banking system. It allows authorized users to update attributes related to consumer services, ensuring that product information is current and accurate. This functionality is crucial for financial institutions and service providers, enabling them to maintain competitive offerings and enhance customer satisfaction. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications, CRM systems, and financial service platforms that require real-time product updates.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific brokered product identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully perform the update operation.
